source.subject: test: admit canonical FP8 register feed

release_test_binary.evidence_note: The mutable build-tree binary is identified by the frozen build-ID log below rather than treated as a persistent artifact.

source.interpretation: The kernel implementations and launchers are test-only inside the existing CUDA translation unit. No public header, production dispatcher, runner, model binding, or sidecar owner changed.

environment.claim_scope: one fixed-clock Orin, exact C512 linear-attention QKV, one pinned checkpoint tensor, isolated test-only kernels

P0.name: canonical_p0
P0.description: canonical row-major raw B is copied through aligned 16-byte cp.async operations into row-major shared memory; the matrix-B fragment is gathered with uint16 loads and fed directly to registers
P0.fragment_gather: two uint16 loads per fragment row half, combined into uint32 and then uint2

P1.name: canonical_p1_xor
P1.description: the only delta from P0 is aligned row-wise XOR placement of the four K16 chunks in shared memory; it retains the same uint16 fragment-gather spelling, global order, cp.async alignment, shared footprint, and register-feed arithmetic
P1.shared_weight_placement: logical K16 chunk XOR lane-derived two-bit key
P1.fragment_gather: the same uint16 gather as P0 with the XOR-adjusted shared chunk

variants.function_identity: P0 and P1 each capture as one kernel and use distinct CUDA Functions
variants.global_traffic_claim: none: measured global requests may change, and no matched NCU run was performed

full_ctest.skip_breakdown: one tokenizer plus eleven external-model/performance tests

validation.production_sentinel_isolation: pass: the pre-existing production sidecar validation remains exact and does not execute the test-only canonical variants

performance_protocol.payload: read-only pinned checkpoint layer-0 QKV tensor
performance_protocol.baseline: canonical production whole-chunk QKV M128 B-reuse kernel
performance_protocol.comparison: aggregate sums all B1/B2 and C1/C2 pass averages across six rounds

P0.decision: reject: clears the 1.15 per-round floor but misses the 1.20 aggregate gate

P1.decision: admit as a test-only baseline-clearing cell

production_sidecar_comparison.protocol: a contemporaneous six-round pinned-checkpoint production-sidecar contract rerun from the same source tree
production_sidecar_comparison.decision: P1 must not replace production QKV: it clears the canonical-baseline gate but is 6.416% slower than the already-promoted sidecar kernel

decision.result: admit P1 canonical raw-B XOR plus uint16 gather register feed as a test-only baseline-clearing cell
decision.P0: rejected at 1.173187x because it misses the frozen 1.20 aggregate gate
decision.P1: passes at 1.222762x with all six rounds at or above 1.222597x and no persistent sidecar
decision.production: unchanged: P1 is 6.416% slower than the 3.211603-ms production sidecar kernel, so it does not replace QKV and does not proceed to QKV NCU, full-model, or dispatch promotion
decision.next_priority: migrate the no-sidecar canonical raw-B XOR/register-feed mechanism to exact-C512 linear-attention Z, then apply its own strict correctness, first-process performance, production-incumbent, and memory gates

limitations: Admission is relative to the canonical row-major production baseline, not relative to the already-promoted QKV sidecar. It is explicitly not a production-selection result.
The isolated cell uses one pinned layer-0 tensor on one fixed-clock Orin. No full-model Prefix, TTFT, Decode, serving, power, or energy result follows.
No NCU or Nsys profile was run for P0/P1, so the record makes no global-load, L1, L2, DRAM, stall, or causal performance claim.
P1 requires no persistent sidecar, but this test-only result does not remove or resize the existing 2.34375-GiB production QKV sidecar.
Production QKV, C256, Decode, MTP policy, FlashInfer policy, buffering, and Prefill/Decode execution remain unchanged.
